description: Smoke-scale defaults: SRSR with 10 neurons, all 9 cells, kernels fitted on 4,000 evenly spaced training points. Not a paper-accurate run.

quantum_reservoir._comment: shots applies to the quantum_noisy reservoir only; null = exact expectations.

kernel._comment: Finite-shot estimation of the noisy kernel (gap diagnosis); null = exact.

photonic._comment: MerLin adaptation: photonic neuron chips and photonic fidelity kernel; see lib/photonic_merlin.py.

classical_reservoir._comment: ReservoirPy 0.4.2 defaults; the paper reports no hyperparameters (R14).

classical_baselines._comment: Fair classical baselines (grids declared before the runs): tuned-ESN grid (nested order sr, lr, input_scaling) and RBF gamma = factor / n_features.

readout._comment_linear_intercept: true: unpenalized intercept (primary); false: paper Eq. 5 without bias (gap diagnosis C).

ibm_brisbane._source: App. B Table B1: median SX error, median ECR error, median readout error

ibm_marrakesh._source: App. B Table B1: median SX error, median CZ error, median readout error

ionq_aria1._source: App. B Table B2: 1 - median 1Q / 2Q / measurement fidelity

noise._comment_scale: Multiplies every App. B error rate (gap diagnosis A); 1.0 = App. B medians.
